claim: 官方 Discussion #297 记录了一次图片识别工具插件参数 schema 根类型错误导致模型函数调用请求失败的报告；dsh-learn 将其中可独立验证的规则收窄为 parameters.type 必须为 object，并提供不联网、不调用模型的本地体检器和离线契约检查。帖子中关于 fork、插件修复和 Harness 修复分支的内容不被写成官方版本已发布修复。

reproduction.environment: macOS; Node.js v25.8.2; local fixtures; no API key; no model request
reproduction.notes: The local doctor passes the correct fixture and rejects a fixture without parameters.type object. The offline lab checks registration, parameter schema, execute and renderer. Dynamic DSH installation and model tool invocation remain NOT_RUN; npm registry access is a separate network preflight. No unknown third-party plugin was installed.
